content:
There is a new Spec for MCP. Has anyone explored what this means for Lean?
https://blog.modelcontextprotocol.io/posts/2026-07-28/

Hi @Bas Spitters , I have implemented MCP 2026-07-28 in Lean Beam.

I was not expecting a new MCP revision, but it fit surprisingly well with the roadmap we had, which was indeed to emulate a kind of stateless mcp protocol to implement multiple Lean workspaces.
In particular it helps for a) having multiple Lean workspaces or LSP servers under the same MCP session (already supported in Beam, with some restrictions) b) remote MCP servers
